faq.q: Which board sub-area is Fox & Aikins North in, and how did it sell in September 2026?
faq.a: The complex sits in Grandview, which recorded Detached 66 listings / 9 solds / 14% and Condos & Townhomes 146 / 20 / 14% in September 2026; the complex itself has no board row (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report, read 2026-11-01)

faq.q: Are Fox & Aikins North and Fox & Aikins South the same complex?
faq.a: No. The live page puts North at 1871 165A Street and its sister phase South at 1833 165A Street, and the developer brochure for South describes that phase as 43 townhomes by Park Ridge Homes (developer source)

faq.q: Which schools are near Fox & Aikins North, by name and address?
faq.a: Ta'talu Elementary at 1970 165a St and Earl Marriott Secondary at 15751 16 Ave, Surrey, both confirmed in the BC Ministry K-12 file; Southridge School (independent) is at 2656 160 St (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01)

faq.q: How long has Park Ridge Homes been building?
faq.a: The developer brochure for the sister South phase describes Park Ridge Homes as a family business building since 1986 (developer source)
